thread:
Maya Patel: Heads up — nightly GPU smoke (h100/multi) turned red on warmup-inference-test after the driver bump this morning. Kernel logs show an OOM-like allocation failure + a kernel WARN during cuLaunchKernel. Test id: nightly-warmup-2026-02-14-03.

Liam Chen: can you paste the job id and node?

Maya Patel: job: run-98321, node: gpu-node-cc-17. Quick snippets below:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU 0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, PID 4218, context 0x7f...
[ 1234.568012] Out of memory: Killed process 4218 (python) total-vm:72000000kB, anon-rss:65000000kB
[ 1234.569000] WARNING: CPU:... in cuLaunchKernel
```

Maya Patel: docker/container image is ubuntu:22.04 + CUDA 12.1 runtime; drivers on host were rolled to 535.54 yesterday. suspicious mismatch?

eng-ci-bot: rerun requested by @Maya Patel for job run-98321 — queued on canary nodes. (CI-12345)

Sophia Rivera: if it's a driver vs runtime mismatch we often see OOMs during large warmups. Please collect: `dmesg -T | tail -n 200`, `nvidia-smi -q`, and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`. Also attach the test artifact tarball from /var/tmp/ci-artifacts/run-98321\.

Rajiv Kapoor: I'll try a quick repro locally on cc-17; if it's node-specific we should mark that node unsched and rerun. Maya can you ssh and run these: `sudo dmesg | tail -n 300 > /tmp/dmesg-run-98321.log` and `sudo tar -czf /tmp/run-98321-logs.tgz /var/log/kern.log /var/log/nvidia/*`

Maya Patel: running those now. FYI canary rerun currently assigned to gpu-node-canary-4.

Liam Chen: if canary passes but cc-17 fails, it's likely hardware/firmware or stale driver residue. Also try setting `TF_GPU_ALLOCATOR=cuda_malloc_async` for the test to see allocator behavior (if applicable).

Maya Patel: uploaded artifacts to: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/run-98321/logs and attached dmesg + nvidia-smi output. dmesg shows repeated: `NVRM: Xid 31` and a lot of `out of memory` lines.

Sophia Rivera: thanks. @Rajiv can you try repro with driver pinned to 520.x on a cc-17-like image? if it reproduces only on 535 then it's the driver. If it reproduces across drivers maybe test stress/regression.

Rajiv Kapoor: quick status — reproduced a soft-failure on cc-17 with 535.54 (OOM at warmup step ~3). On a different node with 535 but different bios firmware it passed. Recording differences now.

Liam Chen: could be a kernel module interaction or PCI BAR sizing issue. Can you capture `/sys/kernel/debug/dma_heap/*` and `lspci -vvv`?

Maya Patel: eng-oncall pinged to evaluate taking cc-17 OOS for now. @eng-oncall are we okay to unsched that node while we bisect?

eng-ci-bot: node gpu-node-cc-17 marked cordoned by @eng-oncall. Reruns will skip this node.

Maya Patel: thanks. Next steps per triage: 1) Rajiv to run driver bisect (520.x -> 535.x) on a repro fixture, 2) Sophia to check kernel module/firmware differences, 3) Liam to review allocator flags and test runtime tweaks. I'll keep the artifacts and smoke rerun links updated here. :thumbsup:

Liam Chen: I can help with the bisect job tomorrow morning — leave the cfg with two driver versions and I'll enqueue.

Rajiv Kapoor: starting bisect now. will drop notes in the issue: https://go/internal/issues/RED-4321

Maya Patel: closing the loop for now — thanks everyone for quick responses. I'll re-open if the bisect shows regression or we see more failing nodes.
